order_items_select_own_or_token.name: order_items_select_own_or_token
order_items_select_own_or_token.using: exists (select 1 from orders where orders.id = order_items.order_id and ((orders.user_id = (select app.current_user_id())) or (orders.access_token is not null and orders.access_token = (select nullif(current_setting('app.order_token', true), '')))))

order_items_insert_own.name: order_items_insert_own
order_items_insert_own.withCheck: exists (select 1 from orders where orders.id = order_items.order_id and (orders.user_id = (select app.current_user_id()) or orders.user_id is null))

orders_select_own_or_token.name: orders_select_own_or_token
orders_select_own_or_token.using: (user_id = (select app.current_user_id())) or (access_token is not null and access_token = (select nullif(current_setting('app.order_token', true), '')))

profiles_name_length.name: profiles_name_length
profiles_name_length.value: ((char_length(first_name) <= 100) OR (first_name IS NULL)) AND ((char_length(last_name) <= 100) OR (last_name IS NULL))

service_requests_select_own.name: service_requests_select_own
service_requests_select_own.using: user_id is not null and user_id = (select app.current_user_id())

unique_stock_product_per_point.name: unique_stock_product_per_point
unique_stock_product_per_point.where: ((product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (modification_id IS NULL))

stock_product_or_modification.name: stock_product_or_modification
stock_product_or_modification.value: ((product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (modification_id IS NULL)) OR ((product_id IS NULL) AND (modification_id IS NOT NULL))
